title: Compare legacy generic and artifact reads within one bounded current-user snapshot scope
description: Stage 2 shared migration engine only; preserve all old routes, four-stage gate, user row/column/menu/data-scope permissions and concurrent work. No arbitrary SQL/joins, independent report, new database/schema, production access/deployment or fabricated proof. Retain exact failure/audit evidence and existing execution budget/cancellation. The evidence service currently reads legacy source, generic preview and legacy artifact in three independent queries. Provide a reusable read scope on the existing scoped database/context so all three reads use the same supported consistent transaction/snapshot and finite parameters. Reuse ERP335 scope behavior where suitable without expanding business write rights; explicitly handle nested transaction/backend limitations and cancellation. Verify matched totals against returned rows on both sides: partial first-page equality cannot prove whole bounded fixture parity. Recheck current menu/data scope after read before recording evidence, retain deterministic disposal and audit correlation; failure invalidates proof rather than returning stale cache. No new schema/database, arbitrary query or modified production isolation settings. Unsupported environment/isolation blocks honestly.
implementation_evidence: ReportMigrationParityEvidenceService.ComputeAsync performs ReadAsync, PreviewAsync and ReadArtifactsAsync separately and ToSnapshot carries the legacy scope fingerprint. ERP335 spans only header/detail composition, not this three-side parity read. Legacy/generic page counts must not silently hide records beyond comparison page.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy snapshot, generic preview and actual legacy output share one bounded supported read scope and normalized current-user parameters; mismatched/full-total truncation is rejected rather than compared as complete.

Source mutation between reads produces a consistent result or accurate rejection; permission revocation/nested transaction/unsupported isolation/cancellation fail closed with audit correlation and no cached cross-user promotion.

Use owned idempotent SQL fixtures with controlled concurrent mutation and permission revocation in guarded NEWERP_AUTOTEST LocalDB; safe Release/unit and scheduler/contracts pass; no production configuration or stage gate change.
